answer: NovaOps's equipment policy states that personal laptops are not allowed for employees, except for a five-business-day IT continuity exception when a managed laptop is being repaired or replaced and the employee has no working device. IT must approve and log the exception before the employee uses a personal machine, even for those five days. All equipment remains NovaOps property, and employees must return it through IT at offboarding or role change​[documents/policies/equipment_policy.md § Personal laptops]​.

During the five-business-day IT continuity exception, IT must approve and log the exception before the employee uses a personal machine, even for those five days. You cannot just go ahead without IT's approval and logging​[documents/policies/equipment_policy.md § Personal laptops]​.
The Equipment Policy is owned by IT, as stated at the top of the policy document​[documents/policies/equipment_policy.md § (whole document)]​.
